senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; סָפַח)rising on the skin, sore. Sifra Thazr., Neg., ch. I (ref. to Lev. XIII, 2) ס׳ שני לשאת (not לבהרת) sappaḥath is secondary to (is a species of) s’eth.
units: Ib.; Shebu. 6ᵇ אין ס׳ אלא טפילה the word sappaḥath itself intimates an attachment to something (ref. to I Sam. II, 36).

<cite ref="Yevamot 47b">Yeb. 47ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 109b">109ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>קשים גרים לישראל כס׳ בעור</he> proselytes are as bad to Israel as a sore on the skin (ref. to <he>ונספחו</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 14:1">Is. XIV, 1</cite>).
